blocks.text: This is a sample scanned document, page 1 of 2.
It was generated to resemble a paper document that has been scanned using a standard flatbed or sheet-fed scanner.
Typical characteristics of a scanned page include: - Slight rotation / skew - Uneven lighting or paper texture - Minor blur compared to a native digital PDF
You can use this file to test OCR pipelines, PDF upload forms, or document viewers.
